Subject: Returns data
Date: Monday 26 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Gus Holloway <gus.holloway@wyndhamretail.example.test>

Gus,

Thank you for the extract. I will write up what the returns data tells us about the peak weeks, though I cannot give you a date until I have looked at the volumes.

You said you would send the store level breakdown by 30 October, which I will fold in.

Best,
Dom
